photos.desc: The short petiole and narrow leaf blade are characteristic.
The leaf blades of narrowleaf popular can be large (e.g., about 15 cm long) but the lance-shape and short petiole are diagnostic .
View of Beecher Island near Wray, Colorado
The petiole that is grooved along the upper side supposedly distinguishes this hybrid from Populus balsamifera.
Cottonwood bark at Beecher Island near Wray, Colorado
